description: This file defines the SandboxTokenParser class in Twig, which is responsible for parsing the 'sandbox' tag in Twig templates. It enforces rules for sandboxed template sections, only permitting include tags and spaces within the sandbox area.
external_methods:
Twig
ode
odetype's methods: getTemplateLine(), getAttribute('data')

classes.name: SandboxTokenParser
classes.description: A parser for the 'sandbox' tag in Twig templates, which creates a SandboxNode for sandboxed sections with specific validation logic.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the sandbox block, ensuring only include nodes or whitespace are within the sandbox, and returns a SandboxNode.

methods.name: decideBlockEnd
methods.description: Determines if the current token signifies the end of the sandbox block.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the string 'sandbox', the tag name this parser handles.
